positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and evolved OS platform for Qualcomm-based automotive ECU, focusing on system stability and boot performance.  
• Key contributor to the inter-domain communication framework connecting QNX, Android Automotive, and embedded controllers.  
• Led root-cause analysis of critical failures, enhancing system reliability across kernel drivers and middleware.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to address complex field and manufacturing issues, ensuring high-quality automotive solutions.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led end-to-end board bring-up (U-Boot, Linux kernel v4.14 / v4.19, device tree) for TI AM5728-based hardware, from bare silicon through production shipment.
- Built and maintained a custom embedded Linux distribution using the Yocto Project; wrote kernel modules in C for backlight, GPIO, and other peripheral interfaces.
- Reviewed schematics and debugged hardware-level PCB issues; configured device tree power rail mappings for the TI TPS659038 PMIC (LDOs and SMPS).
- Designed multi-threaded video processing pipelines using Linux subsystems and vendor IP blocks under tight zero-packet-drop constraints.
- Diagnosed and resolved thermal shutdown faults, reducing overall system power consumption and improving long-term hardware reliability.
- Established CI/CD pipelines for continuous integration and on-target validation of shipping marine electronics.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Involved in development of embedded systems based on Texas Instrument's OMAP3/4 Platforms
- Contributing to board bring up by fixing/adding wide array of peripherals such as touch screens, RF communication modules, USB, wifi, bluetooth and audio
- Maintaining custom embedded Linux distributions, Linux kernel, bootloaders and BSP layers using Yocto Project

projects.title: Porting and Maintaining Linux for Embedded Systems
projects.description: I work to bring-up new hardware, port open-source software such as u-boot, Linux, Yocto/Bitbake and Android to embedded ARM systems, develop, deliver and maintain BSPs, SDKs and software images as well as working with Gumstix customers, developers and upstream communities.
